description: Slacker is a patented system that allows anyone to easily setup their suspension with no assistance. This easy-to-use system quickly mounts to motorcycles and mountain bikes and provides simple, fast, and precise measurements. Slacker shows real-time readings right on the bars using our optional wireless remote, or our free Slacker Virtual Remote smartphone app.
payout_period: Payments are made the first week of the following month by PayPal.
